class.name: HEGoMeshOutput
class.brief_description: Turns the surfaces of a cooked HDA into [MeshInstance3D]s under [code]Outputs/[/code].
class.description: Per output mesh the HDA decides, through detail attributes, whether the mesh is kept in the scene, saved as an [ArrayMesh] resource, or both, and which collision shape (if any) is generated for it.

method.name: output_phase
method.description: Name of the cook phase this handler is timed under.

method.name: should_handle
method.description: Whether the cook produced surfaces worth building.

method.name: fetch_surface_groups
method.description: Fetches the cook's surfaces and groups them the way the HDA asked for. Returns [code]{ mesh_instance_key: { material_key: surface } }[/code], keyed by the hego_mesh_instance and hego_material attributes, with a [code]null[/code] key wherever the geometry does not name one. Empty when the fetch failed or produced nothing. Nothing here touches the scene, so a node that wants to place the result itself can use this and [method build_array_mesh] instead of [method handle].

method.name: fetch_meshes
method.description: One [ArrayMesh] per mesh instance the HDA asked for, without touching the scene. Returns [code]{ mesh_instance_key: ArrayMesh }[/code]. This is the half of [method handle] a custom node usually wants: it builds the meshes and leaves where they go, and whether they are saved as resources, to the caller.

method.name: handle
method.description: Fetches the cook's surfaces and builds the mesh output.

method.name: build_array_mesh
method.description: Builds one [ArrayMesh] from a { material path: surface data } dictionary, adding a surface per material and wiring up LODs and materials.

method.name: save_mesh_resource
method.description: Writes [param mesh] to [param save_path], overwriting an existing [ArrayMesh] in place so that scenes already referencing it pick up the new geometry. Returns { ok, error, fallback_to_instance, message }; [code]message[/code] and [code]error[/code] only carry meaning when [code]ok[/code] is false.

method.name: copy_array_mesh_contents
method.description: Replaces the surfaces of [param target_mesh] with those of [param source_mesh]. Used instead of saving a new resource so the existing [ArrayMesh] object keeps its identity, and everything already pointing at it sees the update.

method.name: load_mesh_resource_fresh
method.description: Loads a saved mesh bypassing the resource cache, so the instance in the scene reflects what was just written to disk.

constants.constant: Category this file logs under, shown in the session panel filter.
Point attributes read for every surface. P always comes along.
Primitive attributes the output is grouped by: one mesh per instance name, one surface per material within it.
Primitive attributes this handler reads off each surface.
Node name used when an HDA does not name its mesh output.
hego_storage_mode: keep the mesh in the scene only.
hego_storage_mode: save the mesh as a resource, do not add it to the scene.
hego_storage_mode: save the mesh as a resource and add an instance of it to the scene.
Properties of [MeshConvexDecompositionSettings] an HDA may override through the hego_col_decomp_settings dictionary. Names match the Godot property names.
